clauses.title: Accidental collision damage
clauses.text: The policy covers direct accidental damage to the insured vehicle caused by a collision, subject to the deductible and evidence requirements.

clauses.title: Required claim evidence
clauses.text: The claimant must provide an incident description, dated repair estimate or invoice, and photographs showing the damaged area. A police report is required when another party is involved.

clauses.title: Excluded circumstances
clauses.text: Damage caused intentionally, during an unauthorized commercial activity, or while the driver is not legally licensed is excluded from coverage.

clauses.title: Settlement and deductible
clauses.text: Approved repair costs are settled up to the insured value after applying the contractual deductible. Differences between the claimed amount and supporting invoices require manual review.
